same identities.


```agda

open import Overture using (𝓞 ; 𝓥 ; Signature)

module Setoid.Varieties.Preservation {𝑆 : Signature 𝓞 𝓥} where

-- Imports from Agda and the Agda Standard Library -------------------------------
open import Agda.Primitive         using ()       renaming ( Set to Type )
open import Data.Product           using ( _,_ )
open import Data.Unit.Polymorphic  using ( ⊤ )
open import Function               using ( _∘_ )  renaming ( Func to _⟶_ )
open import Level                  using ( Level ; _⊔_ )
open import Relation.Binary        using ( Setoid )
open import Relation.Unary         using ( Pred ; _⊆_ ; _∈_ )

-- Imports from the Agda Universal Algebra Library -------------------------------
open import Overture          using ( proj₁ ; proj₂ )
open import Setoid.Functions  using ( IsSurjective ; SurjInv ; SurjInvIsInverseʳ )

open import Overture.Terms   {𝑆 = 𝑆} using ( Term )
open import Setoid.Algebras  {𝑆 = 𝑆} using ( Algebra ; ov ; 𝕌[_] ; Lift-Alg ; ⨅ )

open  import Setoid.Homomorphisms {𝑆 = 𝑆}
      using ( ≅⨅⁺-refl ; ≅-refl ; IdHomImage ; ≅-sym )
open  import Setoid.Terms {𝑆 = 𝑆}
      using ( module Environment; comm-hom-term )
open  import Setoid.Subalgebras {𝑆 = 𝑆}
      using ( _≤_ ; _≤c_ ; ⨅-≤ ; ≅-trans-≤ ; ≤-reflexive )
open  import Setoid.Varieties.Closure {𝑆 = 𝑆}
      using ( H ; S ; P ; S-expa ; H-expa ; V ; P-expa ; V-expa ;Level-closure )
open  import Setoid.Varieties.Properties {𝑆 = 𝑆}
      using ( ⊧-H-invar ; ⊧-S-invar ; ⊧-P-invar ; ⊧-I-invar )
open  import Setoid.Varieties.SoundAndComplete {𝑆 = 𝑆}
      using ( _⊧_ ; _⊨_ ; _⊫_ ; Eq ; _≈̇_ ; lhs ; rhs ; _⊢_▹_≈_ ; Th)

open _⟶_      using ( cong ) renaming ( to to _⟨$⟩_ )
open Algebra  using ( Domain )
```



#### Closure properties

The types defined above represent operators with useful closure properties. We now
prove a handful of such properties that we need later.


```agda
module _  {α ρᵃ ℓ : Level}{𝒦 : Pred(Algebra α ρᵃ) (α ⊔ ρᵃ ⊔ ov ℓ)} where
 private
  a = α ⊔ ρᵃ
  oaℓ = ov (a ⊔ ℓ)

 S⊆SP : ∀{ι} → S ℓ 𝒦 ⊆ S {β = α}{ρᵃ} (a ⊔ ℓ ⊔ ι) (P {β = α}{ρᵃ} ℓ ι 𝒦)
 S⊆SP {ι} (𝑨 , (kA , B≤A )) = 𝑨 , (pA , B≤A)
  where
  pA : 𝑨 ∈ P ℓ ι 𝒦
  pA = ⊤ , (λ _ → 𝑨) , (λ _ → kA) , ≅⨅⁺-refl

 P⊆SP : ∀{ι} → P ℓ ι 𝒦 ⊆ S (a ⊔ ℓ ⊔ ι) (P {β = α}{ρᵃ}ℓ ι 𝒦)
 P⊆SP {ι} x = S-expa{ℓ = a ⊔ ℓ ⊔ ι} x


 P⊆HSP : ∀{ι} →  P {β = α}{ρᵃ} ℓ ι 𝒦
                 ⊆ H (a ⊔ ℓ ⊔ ι) (S {β = α}{ρᵃ}(a ⊔ ℓ ⊔ ι) (P {β = α}{ρᵃ}ℓ ι 𝒦))
 P⊆HSP {ι} x = H-expa{ℓ = a ⊔ ℓ ⊔ ι}  (S-expa{ℓ = a ⊔ ℓ ⊔ ι} x)

 P⊆V : ∀{ι} → P ℓ ι 𝒦 ⊆ V ℓ ι 𝒦
 P⊆V = P⊆HSP

 SP⊆V : ∀{ι} → S{β = α}{ρᵇ = ρᵃ} (a ⊔ ℓ ⊔ ι) (P {β = α}{ρᵃ} ℓ ι 𝒦) ⊆ V ℓ ι 𝒦
 SP⊆V {ι} x = H-expa{ℓ = a ⊔ ℓ ⊔ ι} x
```


Finally, we are in a position to prove that a product of subalgebras of algebras
in a class 𝒦 is a subalgebra of a product of algebras in 𝒦.


```agda

 PS⊆SP {𝑩} (I , ( 𝒜 , sA , B≅⨅A )) = Goal
  where
  ℬ : I → Algebra α ρᵃ
  ℬ i = (proj₁ (sA i))
  kB : (i : I) → ℬ i ∈ 𝒦
  kB i =  proj₁ (proj₂ (sA i))
  ⨅A≤⨅B : ⨅ 𝒜 ≤ ⨅ ℬ
  ⨅A≤⨅B = ⨅-≤ λ i → proj₂ (proj₂ (sA i))
  Goal : 𝑩 ∈ S{β = oaℓ}{oaℓ}oaℓ (P {β = oaℓ}{oaℓ} ℓ oaℓ 𝒦)
  Goal = ⨅ ℬ , (I , (ℬ , (kB , ≅-refl))) , (≅-trans-≤ B≅⨅A ⨅A≤⨅B)
```

First we prove that the closure operator H is compatible with identities that hold in the given class.


```agda
module _   {α ρᵃ ℓ χ : Level}

 H-id1 σ 𝑩 (𝑨 , kA , BimgA) = ⊧-H-invar{p = p}{q} (σ 𝑨 kA) BimgA
```

```agda

 H-id2 Hpq 𝑨 kA = Hpq 𝑨 (𝑨 , (kA , IdHomImage))

```agda

```




#### P preserves identities


```agda

  where
  ih : ∀ i → 𝒜 i ⊧ (p ≈̇ q)
  ih i = σ (𝒜 i) (kA i)
  IH : ⨅ 𝒜 ⊧ (p ≈̇ q)
  IH = ⊧-P-invar {p = p}{q} 𝒜 ih

 -- dsp: lemmas
 -- dsp: end of lemmas

    qℓB 𝑩' kB' = 𝑩 ≅ 𝑩'
      (≅-sym (PKA (qℓA 𝑩 kB)))
      where
        open Setoid (𝔻[ 𝑩 ]) using ( refl )

  PℓA : ∀ {𝑨} → 𝒦 ⊧ (p ℓι 𝒦) 𝑨 → 𝒦 ⊧ (q ℓι 𝒦) 𝑨
  PℓA pℓ𝑨 kA = qℓ𝑨
    where
    open Setoid (𝔻[ 𝑨 ]) using ( refl )
    qℓ𝑨 : 𝒦 ⊧ (q ℓι 𝒦) 𝑨
    qℓ𝑨 𝑩' kB' = 𝑨 ≅ 𝑩'

### Equation preservation for setoid algebras

This is the [Setoid.Varieties.Preservation][] module of the [Agda Universal Algebra Library][] where we show
that the classes \af H `𝒦`{.AgdaBound}, \af S `𝒦`{.AgdaBound}, \af P `𝒦`{.AgdaBound}, and \af V `𝒦`{.AgdaBound} all satisfy the
same identities.


```agda
{-# OPTIONS --cubical-compatible --exact-split #-}

open import Overture using (𝓞 ; 𝓥 ; Signature)

module Setoid.Varieties.Preservation {𝑆 : Signature 𝓞 𝓥} where

-- Imports from Agda and the Agda Standard Library -------------------------------
open import Agda.Primitive         using ()       renaming ( Set to Type )
open import Data.Product           using ( _,_ )
open import Data.Unit.Polymorphic  using ( ⊤ )
open import Function               using ( _∘_ )  renaming ( Func to _⟶_ )
open import Level                  using ( Level ; _⊔_ )
open import Relation.Binary        using ( Setoid )
open import Relation.Unary         using ( Pred ; _⊆_ ; _∈_ )

-- Imports from the Agda Universal Algebra Library -------------------------------
open import Overture          using ( proj₁ ; proj₂ )
open import Setoid.Functions  using ( IsSurjective ; SurjInv ; SurjInvIsInverseʳ )

open import Overture.Terms   {𝑆 = 𝑆} using ( Term )
open import Setoid.Algebras  {𝑆 = 𝑆} using ( Algebra ; ov ; 𝕌[_] ; Lift-Alg ; ⨅ )

open  import Setoid.Homomorphisms {𝑆 = 𝑆}
      using ( ≅⨅⁺-refl ; ≅-refl ; IdHomImage ; ≅-sym )
open  import Setoid.Terms {𝑆 = 𝑆}
      using ( module Environment; comm-hom-term )
open  import Setoid.Subalgebras {𝑆 = 𝑆}
      using ( _≤_ ; _≤c_ ; ⨅-≤ ; ≅-trans-≤ ; ≤-reflexive )
open  import Setoid.Varieties.Closure {𝑆 = 𝑆}
      using ( H ; S ; P ; S-expa ; H-expa ; V ; P-expa ; V-expa ;Level-closure )
open  import Setoid.Varieties.Properties {𝑆 = 𝑆}
      using ( ⊧-H-invar ; ⊧-S-invar ; ⊧-P-invar ; ⊧-I-invar )
open  import Setoid.Varieties.SoundAndComplete {𝑆 = 𝑆}
      using ( _⊧_ ; _⊨_ ; _⊫_ ; Eq ; _≈̇_ ; lhs ; rhs ; _⊢_▹_≈_ ; Th)

open _⟶_      using ( cong ) renaming ( to to _⟨$⟩_ )
open Algebra  using ( Domain )
```



#### Closure properties

The types defined above represent operators with useful closure properties. We now
prove a handful of such properties that we need later.


```agda
module _  {α ρᵃ ℓ : Level}{𝒦 : Pred(Algebra α ρᵃ) (α ⊔ ρᵃ ⊔ ov ℓ)} where
 private
  a = α ⊔ ρᵃ
  oaℓ = ov (a ⊔ ℓ)

 S⊆SP : ∀{ι} → S ℓ 𝒦 ⊆ S {β = α}{ρᵃ} (a ⊔ ℓ ⊔ ι) (P {β = α}{ρᵃ} ℓ ι 𝒦)
 S⊆SP {ι} (𝑨 , (kA , B≤A )) = 𝑨 , (pA , B≤A)
  where
  pA : 𝑨 ∈ P ℓ ι 𝒦
  pA = ⊤ , (λ _ → 𝑨) , (λ _ → kA) , ≅⨅⁺-refl

 P⊆SP : ∀{ι} → P ℓ ι 𝒦 ⊆ S (a ⊔ ℓ ⊔ ι) (P {β = α}{ρᵃ}ℓ ι 𝒦)
 P⊆SP {ι} x = S-expa{ℓ = a ⊔ ℓ ⊔ ι} x


 P⊆HSP : ∀{ι} →  P {β = α}{ρᵃ} ℓ ι 𝒦
                 ⊆ H (a ⊔ ℓ ⊔ ι) (S {β = α}{ρᵃ}(a ⊔ ℓ ⊔ ι) (P {β = α}{ρᵃ}ℓ ι 𝒦))
 P⊆HSP {ι} x = H-expa{ℓ = a ⊔ ℓ ⊔ ι}  (S-expa{ℓ = a ⊔ ℓ ⊔ ι} x)

 P⊆V : ∀{ι} → P ℓ ι 𝒦 ⊆ V ℓ ι 𝒦
 P⊆V = P⊆HSP

 SP⊆V : ∀{ι} → S{β = α}{ρᵇ = ρᵃ} (a ⊔ ℓ ⊔ ι) (P {β = α}{ρᵃ} ℓ ι 𝒦) ⊆ V ℓ ι 𝒦
 SP⊆V {ι} x = H-expa{ℓ = a ⊔ ℓ ⊔ ι} x
```


Finally, we are in a position to prove that a product of subalgebras of algebras
in a class 𝒦 is a subalgebra of a product of algebras in 𝒦.


```agda
 PS⊆SP : P (a ⊔ ℓ) oaℓ (S{β = α}{ρᵃ} ℓ 𝒦) ⊆ S oaℓ (P ℓ oaℓ 𝒦)
 PS⊆SP {𝑩} (I , ( 𝒜 , sA , B≅⨅A )) = Goal
  where
  ℬ : I → Algebra α ρᵃ
  ℬ i = (proj₁ (sA i))
  kB : (i : I) → ℬ i ∈ 𝒦
  kB i =  proj₁ (proj₂ (sA i))
  ⨅A≤⨅B : ⨅ 𝒜 ≤ ⨅ ℬ
  ⨅A≤⨅B = ⨅-≤ λ i → proj₂ (proj₂ (sA i))
  Goal : 𝑩 ∈ S{β = oaℓ}{oaℓ}oaℓ (P {β = oaℓ}{oaℓ} ℓ oaℓ 𝒦)
  Goal = ⨅ ℬ , (I , (ℬ , (kB , ≅-refl))) , (≅-trans-≤ B≅⨅A ⨅A≤⨅B)
```


#### H preserves identities

First we prove that the closure operator H is compatible with identities that hold in the given class.


```agda
module _   {α ρᵃ ℓ χ : Level}
           {𝒦 : Pred(Algebra α ρᵃ) (α ⊔ ρᵃ ⊔ ov ℓ)}
           {X : Type χ}
           {p q : Term X}
           where

 H-id1 : 𝒦 ⊫ (p ≈̇ q) → H {β = α}{ρᵃ}ℓ 𝒦 ⊫ (p ≈̇ q)
 H-id1 σ 𝑩 (𝑨 , kA , BimgA) = ⊧-H-invar{p = p}{q} (σ 𝑨 kA) BimgA
```


The converse of the foregoing result is almost too obvious to bother with. Nonetheless, we formalize it for completeness.


```agda
 H-id2 : H ℓ 𝒦 ⊫ (p ≈̇ q) → 𝒦 ⊫ (p ≈̇ q)
 H-id2 Hpq 𝑨 kA = Hpq 𝑨 (𝑨 , (kA , IdHomImage))
```



#### S preserves identities


```agda
 S-id1 : 𝒦 ⊫ (p ≈̇ q) → (S {β = α}{ρᵃ} ℓ 𝒦) ⊫ (p ≈̇ q)
 S-id1 σ 𝑩 (𝑨 , kA , B≤A) = ⊧-S-invar{p = p}{q} (σ 𝑨 kA) B≤A

 S-id2 : S ℓ 𝒦 ⊫ (p ≈̇ q) → 𝒦 ⊫ (p ≈̇ q)
 S-id2 Spq 𝑨 kA = Spq 𝑨 (𝑨 , (kA , ≤-reflexive))
```




#### P preserves identities


```agda
 P-id1 : ∀{ι} → 𝒦 ⊫ (p ≈̇ q) → P {β = α}{ρᵃ}ℓ ι 𝒦 ⊫ (p ≈̇ q)
 P-id1 σ 𝑨 (I , 𝒜 , kA , A≅⨅A) = ⊧-I-invar 𝑨 p q IH (≅-sym A≅⨅A)
  where
  ih : ∀ i → 𝒜 i ⊧ (p ≈̇ q)
  ih i = σ (𝒜 i) (kA i)
  IH : ⨅ 𝒜 ⊧ (p ≈̇ q)
  IH = ⊧-P-invar {p = p}{q} 𝒜 ih

 -- dsp: lemmas
 -- dsp: end of lemmas
 P-id2 : ∀{ι} → P ℓ ι 𝒦 ⊫ (p ≈̇ q) → 𝒦 ⊫ (p ≈̇ q)
 P-id2 {𝑨} PA pq = {!!}

### Equation preservation for setoid algebras

This is the [Setoid.Varieties.Preservation][] module of the [Agda Universal Algebra Library][] where we show
that the classes \af H `𝒦`{.AgdaBound}, \af S `𝒦`{.AgdaBound}, \af P `𝒦`{.AgdaBound}, and \af V `𝒦`{.AgdaBound} all satisfy the
same identities.


```agda
{-# OPTIONS --cubical-compatible --exact-split #-}

open import Overture using (𝓞 ; 𝓥 ; Signature)

module Setoid.Varieties.Preservation {𝑆 : Signature 𝓞 𝓥} where

-- Imports from Agda and the Agda Standard Library -------------------------------
open import Agda.Primitive         using ()       renaming ( Set to Type )
open import Data.Product           using ( _,_ )
open import Data.Unit.Polymorphic  using ( ⊤ )
open import Function               using ( _∘_ )  renaming ( Func to _⟶_ )
open import Level                  using ( Level ; _⊔_ )
open import Relation.Binary        using ( Setoid )
open import Relation.Unary         using ( Pred ; _⊆_ ; _∈_ )

-- Imports from the Agda Universal Algebra Library -------------------------------
open import Overture          using ( proj₁ ; proj₂ )
open import Setoid.Functions  using ( IsSurjective ; SurjInv ; SurjInvIsInverseʳ )

open import Overture.Terms   {𝑆 = 𝑆} using ( Term )
open import Setoid.Algebras  {𝑆 = 𝑆} using ( Algebra ; ov ; 𝕌[_] ; Lift-Alg ; ⨅ )

open  import Setoid.Homomorphisms {𝑆 = 𝑆}
      using ( ≅⨅⁺-refl ; ≅-refl ; IdHomImage ; ≅-sym )
open  import Setoid.Terms {𝑆 = 𝑆}
      using ( module Environment; comm-hom-term )
open  import Setoid.Subalgebras {𝑆 = 𝑆}
      using ( _≤_ ; _≤c_ ; ⨅-≤ ; ≅-trans-≤ ; ≤-reflexive )
open  import Setoid.Varieties.Closure {𝑆 = 𝑆}
      using ( H ; S ; P ; S-expa ; H-expa ; V ; P-expa ; V-expa ;Level-closure )
open  import Setoid.Varieties.Properties {𝑆 = 𝑆}
      using ( ⊧-H-invar ; ⊧-S-invar ; ⊧-P-invar ; ⊧-I-invar )
open  import Setoid.Varieties.SoundAndComplete {𝑆 = 𝑆}
      using ( _⊧_ ; _⊨_ ; _⊫_ ; Eq ; _≈̇_ ; lhs ; rhs ; _⊢_▹_≈_ ; Th)

open _⟶_      using ( cong ) renaming ( to to _⟨$⟩_ )
open Algebra  using ( Domain )
```



#### Closure properties

The types defined above represent operators with useful closure properties. We now
prove a handful of such properties that we need later.


```agda
module _  {α ρᵃ ℓ : Level}{𝒦 : Pred(Algebra α ρᵃ) (α ⊔ ρᵃ ⊔ ov ℓ)} where
 private
  a = α ⊔ ρᵃ
  oaℓ = ov (a ⊔ ℓ)

 S⊆SP : ∀{ι} → S ℓ 𝒦 ⊆ S {β = α}{ρᵃ} (a ⊔ ℓ ⊔ ι) (P {β = α}{ρᵃ} ℓ ι 𝒦)
 S⊆SP {ι} (𝑨 , (kA , B≤A )) = 𝑨 , (pA , B≤A)
  where
  pA : 𝑨 ∈ P ℓ ι 𝒦
  pA = ⊤ , (λ _ → 𝑨) , (λ _ → kA) , ≅⨅⁺-refl

 P⊆SP : ∀{ι} → P ℓ ι 𝒦 ⊆ S (a ⊔ ℓ ⊔ ι) (P {β = α}{ρᵃ}ℓ ι 𝒦)
 P⊆SP {ι} x = S-expa{ℓ = a ⊔ ℓ ⊔ ι} x


 P⊆HSP : ∀{ι} →  P {β = α}{ρᵃ} ℓ ι 𝒦
                 ⊆ H (a ⊔ ℓ ⊔ ι) (S {β = α}{ρᵃ}(a ⊔ ℓ ⊔ ι) (P {β = α}{ρᵃ}ℓ ι 𝒦))
 P⊆HSP {ι} x = H-expa{ℓ = a ⊔ ℓ ⊔ ι}  (S-expa{ℓ = a ⊔ ℓ ⊔ ι} x)

 P⊆V : ∀{ι} → P ℓ ι 𝒦 ⊆ V ℓ ι 𝒦
 P⊆V = P⊆HSP

 SP⊆V : ∀{ι} → S{β = α}{ρᵇ = ρᵃ} (a ⊔ ℓ ⊔ ι) (P {β = α}{ρᵃ} ℓ ι 𝒦) ⊆ V ℓ ι 𝒦
 SP⊆V {ι} x = H-expa{ℓ = a ⊔ ℓ ⊔ ι} x
```


Finally, we are in a position to prove that a product of subalgebras of algebras
in a class 𝒦 is a subalgebra of a product of algebras in 𝒦.


```agda
 PS⊆SP : P (a ⊔ ℓ) oaℓ (S{β = α}{ρᵃ} ℓ 𝒦) ⊆ S oaℓ (P ℓ oaℓ 𝒦)
 PS⊆SP {𝑩} (I , ( 𝒜 , sA , B≅⨅A )) = Goal
  where
  ℬ : I → Algebra α ρᵃ
  ℬ i = (proj₁ (sA i))
  kB : (i : I) → ℬ i ∈ 𝒦
  kB i =  proj₁ (proj₂ (sA i))
  ⨅A≤⨅B : ⨅ 𝒜 ≤ ⨅ ℬ
  ⨅A≤⨅B = ⨅-≤ λ i → proj₂ (proj₂ (sA i))
  Goal : 𝑩 ∈ S{β = oaℓ}{oaℓ}oaℓ (P {β = oaℓ}{oaℓ} ℓ oaℓ 𝒦)
  Goal = ⨅ ℬ , (I , (ℬ , (kB , ≅-refl))) , (≅-trans-≤ B≅⨅A ⨅A≤⨅B)
```


#### H preserves identities

First we prove that the closure operator H is compatible with identities that hold in the given class.


```agda
module _   {α ρᵃ ℓ χ : Level}
           {𝒦 : Pred(Algebra α ρᵃ) (α ⊔ ρᵃ ⊔ ov ℓ)}
           {X : Type χ}
           {p q : Term X}
           where

 H-id1 : 𝒦 ⊫ (p ≈̇ q) → H {β = α}{ρᵃ}ℓ 𝒦 ⊫ (p ≈̇ q)
 H-id1 σ 𝑩 (𝑨 , kA , BimgA) = ⊧-H-invar{p = p}{q} (σ 𝑨 kA) BimgA
```


The converse of the foregoing result is almost too obvious to bother with. Nonetheless, we formalize it for completeness.


```agda
 H-id2 : H ℓ 𝒦 ⊫ (p ≈̇ q) → 𝒦 ⊫ (p ≈̇ q)
 H-id2 Hpq 𝑨 kA = Hpq 𝑨 (𝑨 , (kA , IdHomImage))
```



#### S preserves identities


```agda
 S-id1 : 𝒦 ⊫ (p ≈̇ q) → (S {β = α}{ρᵃ} ℓ 𝒦) ⊫ (p ≈̇ q)
 S-id1 σ 𝑩 (𝑨 , kA , B≤A) = ⊧-S-invar{p = p}{q} (σ 𝑨 kA) B≤A

 S-id2 : S ℓ 𝒦 ⊫ (p ≈̇ q) → 𝒦 ⊫ (p ≈̇ q)
 S-id2 Spq 𝑨 kA = Spq 𝑨 (𝑨 , (kA , ≤-reflexive))
```




#### P preserves identities


```agda
 P-id1 : ∀{ι} → 𝒦 ⊫ (p ≈̇ q) → P {β = α}{ρᵃ}ℓ ι 𝒦 ⊫ (p ≈̇ q)
 P-id1 σ 𝑨 (I , 𝒜 , kA , A≅⨅A) = ⊧-I-invar 𝑨 p q IH (≅-sym A≅⨅A)
  where
  ih : ∀ i → 𝒜 i ⊧ (p ≈̇ q)
  ih i = σ (𝒜 i) (kA i)
  IH : ⨅ 𝒜 ⊧ (p ≈̇ q)
  IH = ⊧-P-invar {p = p}{q} 𝒜 ih

 -- dsp: lemmas
 -- dsp: end of lemmas
 Pid2-gap0 : (α : Level) → (ρᵃ : Level) → (ℓ : Level) → (χ : Level) → (𝒦 : Pred (Algebra α ρᵃ) (α ⊔ ρᵃ ⊔ ov ℓ)) → (X : Type χ) → (p : Term X) → (q : Term X) → (ι : Level) → (Ppq : P ℓ ι 𝒦 ⊫ p ≈̇ q) → (𝑨 : Algebra α ρᵃ) → (kA : 𝒦 𝑨) → P ℓ ι 𝒦 𝑨
 Pid2-gap0 α ρᵃ ℓ χ 𝒦 X p q ι Ppq 𝑨 kA = π , (λ { (𝑩 , sB , h , hsurjective , hhom ) →
   ϕ , (λ { (𝑨 , sA , g , ghom , gEquiv ) →
     lift (ghom (proj₁ h)) , goal
     })
   })
   where
   ϕ : hom (kercon {α}{ρᵃ} ℓ (Ppq 𝑨 kA)) 𝑨
   ϕ = π
   goal : kercon ℓ (Ppq 𝑨 kA) 𝑨 ∣ ϕ ∣
   goal (𝑩 , sB , h , hsurjective , hhom) =
     kercon-interp-cong ℓ (Ppq 𝑨 kA) 𝑨 h (λ { (𝑨' , sA' , g , ghom , gEquiv) →
       kercon-interp-cong ℓ (Ppq 𝑨 kA) 𝑨' g (λ { x →
         var x ≡⟨ ≡.sym (term-eval-sg 𝑨 kA x)) ⟩
         (𝑨 ⟦ p ⟧ ⟨$⟩ g x) ≡⟨ (Ppq 𝑨 kA) (ℊ x) (ℊ x) (≡.refl , ≡.refl) ⟩
         (𝑨 ⟦ q ⟧ ⟨$⟩ g x) ≡⟨ term-eval-sg 𝑨 kA x ⟩
         var x ∎ })
     })
```

### Equation preservation for setoid algebras

This is the [Setoid.Varieties.Preservation][] module of the [Agda Universal Algebra Library][] where we show
that the classes \af H `𝒦`{.AgdaBound}, \af S `𝒦`{.AgdaBound}, \af P `𝒦`{.AgdaBound}, and \af V `𝒦`{.AgdaBound} all satisfy the
same identities.


```agda
{-# OPTIONS --cubical-compatible --exact-split #-}

open import Overture using (𝓞 ; 𝓥 ; Signature)

module Setoid.Varieties.Preservation {𝑆 : Signature 𝓞 𝓥} where

-- Imports from Agda and the Agda Standard Library -------------------------------
open import Agda.Primitive         using ()       renaming ( Set to Type )
open import Data.Product           using ( _,_ )
open import Data.Unit.Polymorphic  using ( ⊤ )
open import Function               using ( _∘_ )  renaming ( Func to _⟶_ )
open import Level                  using ( Level ; _⊔_ )
open import Relation.Binary        using ( Setoid )
open import Relation.Unary         using ( Pred ; _⊆_ ; _∈_ )

-- Imports from the Agda Universal Algebra Library -------------------------------
open import Overture          using ( proj₁ ; proj₂ )
open import Setoid.Functions  using ( IsSurjective ; SurjInv ; SurjInvIsInverseʳ )

open import Overture.Terms   {𝑆 = 𝑆} using ( Term )
open import Setoid.Algebras  {𝑆 = 𝑆} using ( Algebra ; ov ; 𝕌[_] ; Lift-Alg ; ⨅ )

open  import Setoid.Homomorphisms {𝑆 = 𝑆}
      using ( ≅⨅⁺-refl ; ≅-refl ; IdHomImage ; ≅-sym )
open  import Setoid.Terms {𝑆 = 𝑆}
      using ( module Environment; comm-hom-term )
open  import Setoid.Subalgebras {𝑆 = 𝑆}
      using ( _≤_ ; _≤c_ ; ⨅-≤ ; ≅-trans-≤ ; ≤-reflexive )
open  import Setoid.Varieties.Closure {𝑆 = 𝑆}
      using ( H ; S ; P ; S-expa ; H-expa ; V ; P-expa ; V-expa ;Level-closure )
open  import Setoid.Varieties.Properties {𝑆 = 𝑆}
      using ( ⊧-H-invar ; ⊧-S-invar ; ⊧-P-invar ; ⊧-I-invar )
open  import Setoid.Varieties.SoundAndComplete {𝑆 = 𝑆}
      using ( _⊧_ ; _⊨_ ; _⊫_ ; Eq ; _≈̇_ ; lhs ; rhs ; _⊢_▹_≈_ ; Th)

open _⟶_      using ( cong ) renaming ( to to _⟨$⟩_ )
open Algebra  using ( Domain )
```



#### Closure properties

The types defined above represent operators with useful closure properties. We now
prove a handful of such properties that we need later.


```agda
module _  {α ρᵃ ℓ : Level}{𝒦 : Pred(Algebra α ρᵃ) (α ⊔ ρᵃ ⊔ ov ℓ)} where
 private
  a = α ⊔ ρᵃ
  oaℓ = ov (a ⊔ ℓ)

 S⊆SP : ∀{ι} → S ℓ 𝒦 ⊆ S {β = α}{ρᵃ} (a ⊔ ℓ ⊔ ι) (P {β = α}{ρᵃ} ℓ ι 𝒦)
 S⊆SP {ι} (𝑨 , (kA , B≤A )) = 𝑨 , (pA , B≤A)
  where
  pA : 𝑨 ∈ P ℓ ι 𝒦
  pA = ⊤ , (λ _ → 𝑨) , (λ _ → kA) , ≅⨅⁺-refl

 P⊆SP : ∀{ι} → P ℓ ι 𝒦 ⊆ S (a ⊔ ℓ ⊔ ι) (P {β = α}{ρᵃ}ℓ ι 𝒦)
 P⊆SP {ι} x = S-expa{ℓ = a ⊔ ℓ ⊔ ι} x


 P⊆HSP : ∀{ι} →  P {β = α}{ρᵃ} ℓ ι 𝒦
                 ⊆ H (a ⊔ ℓ ⊔ ι) (S {β = α}{ρᵃ}(a ⊔ ℓ ⊔ ι) (P {β = α}{ρᵃ}ℓ ι 𝒦))
 P⊆HSP {ι} x = H-expa{ℓ = a ⊔ ℓ ⊔ ι}  (S-expa{ℓ = a ⊔ ℓ ⊔ ι} x)

 P⊆V : ∀{ι} → P ℓ ι 𝒦 ⊆ V ℓ ι 𝒦
 P⊆V = P⊆HSP

 SP⊆V : ∀{ι} → S{β = α}{ρᵇ = ρᵃ} (a ⊔ ℓ ⊔ ι) (P {β = α}{ρᵃ} ℓ ι 𝒦) ⊆ V ℓ ι 𝒦
 SP⊆V {ι} x = H-expa{ℓ = a ⊔ ℓ ⊔ ι} x
```


Finally, we are in a position to prove that a product of subalgebras of algebras
in a class 𝒦 is a subalgebra of a product of algebras in 𝒦.


```agda
 PS⊆SP : P (a ⊔ ℓ) oaℓ (S{β = α}{ρᵃ} ℓ 𝒦) ⊆ S oaℓ (P ℓ oaℓ 𝒦)
 PS⊆SP {𝑩} (I , ( 𝒜 , sA , B≅⨅A )) = Goal
  where
  ℬ : I → Algebra α ρᵃ
  ℬ i = (proj₁ (sA i))
  kB : (i : I) → ℬ i ∈ 𝒦
  kB i =  proj₁ (proj₂ (sA i))
  ⨅A≤⨅B : ⨅ 𝒜 ≤ ⨅ ℬ
  ⨅A≤⨅B = ⨅-≤ λ i → proj₂ (proj₂ (sA i))
  Goal : 𝑩 ∈ S{β = oaℓ}{oaℓ}oaℓ (P {β = oaℓ}{oaℓ} ℓ oaℓ 𝒦)
  Goal = ⨅ ℬ , (I , (ℬ , (kB , ≅-refl))) , (≅-trans-≤ B≅⨅A ⨅A≤⨅B)
```


#### H preserves identities

First we prove that the closure operator H is compatible with identities that hold in the given class.


```agda
module _   {α ρᵃ ℓ χ : Level}
           {𝒦 : Pred(Algebra α ρᵃ) (α ⊔ ρᵃ ⊔ ov ℓ)}
           {X : Type χ}
           {p q : Term X}
           where

 H-id1 : 𝒦 ⊫ (p ≈̇ q) → H {β = α}{ρᵃ}ℓ 𝒦 ⊫ (p ≈̇ q)
 H-id1 σ 𝑩 (𝑨 , kA , BimgA) = ⊧-H-invar{p = p}{q} (σ 𝑨 kA) BimgA
```


The converse of the foregoing result is almost too obvious to bother with. Nonetheless, we formalize it for completeness.


```agda
 H-id2 : H ℓ 𝒦 ⊫ (p ≈̇ q) → 𝒦 ⊫ (p ≈̇ q)
 H-id2 Hpq 𝑨 kA = Hpq 𝑨 (𝑨 , (kA , IdHomImage))
```



#### S preserves identities


```agda
 S-id1 : 𝒦 ⊫ (p ≈̇ q) → (S {β = α}{ρᵃ} ℓ 𝒦) ⊫ (p ≈̇ q)
 S-id1 σ 𝑩 (𝑨 , kA , B≤A) = ⊧-S-invar{p = p}{q} (σ 𝑨 kA) B≤A

 S-id2 : S ℓ 𝒦 ⊫ (p ≈̇ q) → 𝒦 ⊫ (p ≈̇ q)
 S-id2 Spq 𝑨 kA = Spq 𝑨 (𝑨 , (kA , ≤-reflexive))
```




#### P preserves identities


```agda
 P-id1 : ∀{ι} → 𝒦 ⊫ (p ≈̇ q) → P {β = α}{ρᵃ}ℓ ι 𝒦 ⊫ (p ≈̇ q)
 P-id1 σ 𝑨 (I , 𝒜 , kA , A≅⨅A) = ⊧-I-invar 𝑨 p q IH (≅-sym A≅⨅A)
  where
  ih : ∀ i → 𝒜 i ⊧ (p ≈̇ q)
  ih i = σ (𝒜 i) (kA i)
  IH : ⨅ 𝒜 ⊧ (p ≈̇ q)
  IH = ⊧-P-invar {p = p}{q} 𝒜 ih

 -- dsp: lemmas
 -- dsp: end of lemmas
 Pid2-gap0 : (α : Level) → (ρᵃ : Level) → (ℓ : Level) → (χ : Level) → (𝒦 : Pred (Algebra α ρᵃ) (α ⊔ ρᵃ ⊔ ov ℓ)) → (X : Type χ) → (p : Term X) → (q : Term X) → (ι : Level) → (Ppq : P ℓ ι 𝒦 ⊫ p ≈̇ q) → (𝑨 : Algebra α ρᵃ) → (kA : 𝒦 𝑨) → P ℓ ι 𝒦 𝑨
 Pid2-gap0 α ρᵃ ℓ χ 𝒦 X p q ι Ppq 𝑨 kA = π , {!!}```

open  import Setoid.Varieties.Closure {𝑆 = 𝑆}

open  import Setoid.Varieties.Properties {𝑆 = 𝑆}
      using ( ⊧-H-invar ; ⊧-S-invar ; ⊧-P-invar ; ⊧-I-invar )

### Equation preservation for setoid algebras

This is the [Setoid.Varieties.Preservation][] module of the [Agda Universal Algebra Library][] where we show
that the classes \af H `𝒦`{.AgdaBound}, \af S `𝒦`{.AgdaBound}, \af P `𝒦`{.AgdaBound}, and \af V `𝒦`{.AgdaBound} all satisfy the
same identities.


```agda
{-# OPTIONS --cubical-compatible --exact-split #-}

open import Overture using (𝓞 ; 𝓥 ; Signature)

module Setoid.Varieties.Preservation {𝑆 : Signature 𝓞 𝓥} where

-- Imports from Agda and the Agda Standard Library -------------------------------
open import Agda.Primitive         using ()       renaming ( Set to Type )
open import Data.Product           using ( _,_ )
open import Data.Unit.Polymorphic  using ( ⊤ )
open import Function               using ( _∘_ )  renaming ( Func to _⟶_ )
open import Level                  using ( Level ; _⊔_ )
open import Relation.Binary        using ( Setoid )
open import Relation.Unary         using ( Pred ; _⊆_ ; _∈_ )

-- Imports from the Agda Universal Algebra Library -------------------------------
open import Overture          using ( proj₁ ; proj₂ )
open import Setoid.Functions  using ( IsSurjective ; SurjInv ; SurjInvIsInverseʳ )

open import Overture.Terms   {𝑆 = 𝑆} using ( Term )
open import Setoid.Algebras  {𝑆 = 𝑆} using ( Algebra ; ov ; 𝕌[_] ; Lift-Alg ; ⨅ )

open  import Setoid.Homomorphisms {𝑆 = 𝑆}
      using ( ≅⨅⁺-refl ; ≅-refl ; IdHomImage ; ≅-sym )
open  import Setoid.Terms {𝑆 = 𝑆}
      using ( module Environment; comm-hom-term )
open  import Setoid.Subalgebras {𝑆 = 𝑆}
      using ( _≤_ ; _≤c_ ; ⨅-≤ ; ≅-trans-≤ ; ≤-reflexive )
open  import Setoid.Varieties.Closure {𝑆 = 𝑆}
      using ( H ; S ; P ; S-expa ; H-expa ; V ; P-expa ; V-expa ;Level-closure )
open  import Setoid.Varieties.Properties {𝑆 = 𝑆}
      using ( ⊧-H-invar ; ⊧-S-invar ; ⊧-P-invar ; ⊧-I-invar )
open  import Setoid.Varieties.SoundAndComplete {𝑆 = 𝑆}
      using ( _⊧_ ; _⊨_ ; _⊫_ ; Eq ; _≈̇_ ; lhs ; rhs ; _⊢_▹_≈_ ; Th)

open _⟶_      using ( cong ) renaming ( to to _⟨$⟩_ )
open Algebra  using ( Domain )
```



#### Closure properties

The types defined above represent operators with useful closure properties. We now
prove a handful of such properties that we need later.


```agda
module _  {α ρᵃ ℓ : Level}{𝒦 : Pred(Algebra α ρᵃ) (α ⊔ ρᵃ ⊔ ov ℓ)} where
 private
  a = α ⊔ ρᵃ
  oaℓ = ov (a ⊔ ℓ)

 S⊆SP : ∀{ι} → S ℓ 𝒦 ⊆ S {β = α}{ρᵃ} (a ⊔ ℓ ⊔ ι) (P {β = α}{ρᵃ} ℓ ι 𝒦)
 S⊆SP {ι} (𝑨 , (kA , B≤A )) = 𝑨 , (pA , B≤A)
  where
  pA : 𝑨 ∈ P ℓ ι 𝒦
  pA = ⊤ , (λ _ → 𝑨) , (λ _ → kA) , ≅⨅⁺-refl

 P⊆SP : ∀{ι} → P ℓ ι 𝒦 ⊆ S (a ⊔ ℓ ⊔ ι) (P {β = α}{ρᵃ}ℓ ι 𝒦)
 P⊆SP {ι} x = S-expa{ℓ = a ⊔ ℓ ⊔ ι} x


 P⊆HSP : ∀{ι} →  P {β = α}{ρᵃ} ℓ ι 𝒦
                 ⊆ H (a ⊔ ℓ ⊔ ι) (S {β = α}{ρᵃ}(a ⊔ ℓ ⊔ ι) (P {β = α}{ρᵃ}ℓ ι 𝒦))
 P⊆HSP {ι} x = H-expa{ℓ = a ⊔ ℓ ⊔ ι}  (S-expa{ℓ = a ⊔ ℓ ⊔ ι} x)

 P⊆V : ∀{ι} → P ℓ ι 𝒦 ⊆ V ℓ ι 𝒦
 P⊆V = P⊆HSP

 SP⊆V : ∀{ι} → S{β = α}{ρᵇ = ρᵃ} (a ⊔ ℓ ⊔ ι) (P {β = α}{ρᵃ} ℓ ι 𝒦) ⊆ V ℓ ι 𝒦
 SP⊆V {ι} x = H-expa{ℓ = a ⊔ ℓ ⊔ ι} x
```


Finally, we are in a position to prove that a product of subalgebras of algebras
in a class 𝒦 is a subalgebra of a product of algebras in 𝒦.


```agda
 PS⊆SP : P (a ⊔ ℓ) oaℓ (S{β = α}{ρᵃ} ℓ 𝒦) ⊆ S oaℓ (P ℓ oaℓ 𝒦)
 PS⊆SP {𝑩} (I , ( 𝒜 , sA , B≅⨅A )) = Goal
  where
  ℬ : I → Algebra α ρᵃ
  ℬ i = (proj₁ (sA i))
  kB : (i : I) → ℬ i ∈ 𝒦
  kB i =  proj₁ (proj₂ (sA i))
  ⨅A≤⨅B : ⨅ 𝒜 ≤ ⨅ ℬ
  ⨅A≤⨅B = ⨅-≤ λ i → proj₂ (proj₂ (sA i))
  Goal : 𝑩 ∈ S{β = oaℓ}{oaℓ}oaℓ (P {β = oaℓ}{oaℓ} ℓ oaℓ 𝒦)
  Goal = ⨅ ℬ , (I , (ℬ , (kB , ≅-refl))) , (≅-trans-≤ B≅⨅A ⨅A≤⨅B)
```


#### H preserves identities

First we prove that the closure operator H is compatible with identities that hold in the given class.


```agda
module _   {α ρᵃ ℓ χ : Level}
           {𝒦 : Pred(Algebra α ρᵃ) (α ⊔ ρᵃ ⊔ ov ℓ)}
           {X : Type χ}
           {p q : Term X}
           where

 H-id1 : 𝒦 ⊫ (p ≈̇ q) → H {β = α}{ρᵃ}ℓ 𝒦 ⊫ (p ≈̇ q)
 H-id1 σ 𝑩 (𝑨 , kA , BimgA) = ⊧-H-invar{p = p}{q} (σ 𝑨 kA) BimgA
```


The converse of the foregoing result is almost too obvious to bother with. Nonetheless, we formalize it for completeness.


```agda
 H-id2 : H ℓ 𝒦 ⊫ (p ≈̇ q) → 𝒦 ⊫ (p ≈̇ q)
 H-id2 Hpq 𝑨 kA = Hpq 𝑨 (𝑨 , (kA , IdHomImage))
```



#### S preserves identities


```agda
 S-id1 : 𝒦 ⊫ (p ≈̇ q) → (S {β = α}{ρᵃ} ℓ 𝒦) ⊫ (p ≈̇ q)
 S-id1 σ 𝑩 (𝑨 , kA , B≤A) = ⊧-S-invar{p = p}{q} (σ 𝑨 kA) B≤A

 S-id2 : S ℓ 𝒦 ⊫ (p ≈̇ q) → 𝒦 ⊫ (p ≈̇ q)
 S-id2 Spq 𝑨 kA = Spq 𝑨 (𝑨 , (kA , ≤-reflexive))
```

```agda

 P-id1 σ 𝑨 (I , 𝒜 , kA , A≅⨅A) = ⊧-I-invar 𝑨 p q IH (≅-sym A≅⨅A)
  where
  ih : ∀ i → 𝒜 i ⊧ (p ≈̇ q)
  ih i = σ (𝒜 i) (kA i)
  IH : ⨅ 𝒜 ⊧ (p ≈̇ q)
  IH = ⊧-P-invar {p = p}{q} 𝒜 ih

This is the [Setoid.Varieties.Preservation][] module of the [Agda Universal Algebra Library][] where we show
that the classes \af H `𝒦`{.AgdaBound}, \af S `𝒦`{.AgdaBound}, \af P `𝒦`{.AgdaBound}, and \af V `𝒦`{.AgdaBound} all satisfy the
same identities.

-- Imports from Agda and the Agda Standard Library -------------------------------
open import Agda.Primitive         using ()       renaming ( Set to Type )
open import Data.Product           using ( _,_ )
open import Data.Unit.Polymorphic  using ( ⊤ )
open import Function               using ( _∘_ )  renaming ( Func to _⟶_ )

-- Imports from the Agda Universal Algebra Library -------------------------------
open import Overture          using ( proj₁ ; proj₂ )

open import Overture.Terms   {𝑆 = 𝑆} using ( Term )
open import Setoid.Algebras  {𝑆 = 𝑆} using ( Algebra ; ov ; 𝕌[_] ; Lift-Alg ; ⨅ )

open  import Setoid.Homomorphisms {𝑆 = 𝑆}
      using ( ≅⨅⁺-refl ; ≅-refl ; IdHomImage ; ≅-sym )
open  import Setoid.Terms {𝑆 = 𝑆}
      using ( module Environment; comm-hom-term )
open  import Setoid.Subalgebras {𝑆 = 𝑆}
      using ( _≤_ ; _≤c_ ; ⨅-≤ ; ≅-trans-≤ ; ≤-reflexive )
open  import Setoid.Varieties.Closure {𝑆 = 𝑆}
      using ( H ; S ; P ; S-expa ; H-expa ; V ; P-expa ; V-expa ;Level-closure )
open  import Setoid.Varieties.Properties {𝑆 = 𝑆}
      using ( ⊧-H-invar ; ⊧-S-invar ; ⊧-P-invar ; ⊧-I-invar )
open  import Setoid.Varieties.SoundAndComplete {𝑆 = 𝑆}
      using ( _⊧_ ; _⊨_ ; _⊫_ ; Eq ; _≈̇_ ; lhs ; rhs ; _⊢_▹_≈_ ; Th)

open _⟶_      using ( cong ) renaming ( to to _⟨$⟩_ )
open Algebra  using ( Domain )
```



#### Closure properties

The types defined above represent operators with useful closure properties. We now
prove a handful of such properties that we need later.


```agda
module _  {α ρᵃ ℓ : Level}{𝒦 : Pred(Algebra α ρᵃ) (α ⊔ ρᵃ ⊔ ov ℓ)} where
 private
  a = α ⊔ ρᵃ
  oaℓ = ov (a ⊔ ℓ)

 S⊆SP : ∀{ι} → S ℓ 𝒦 ⊆ S {β = α}{ρᵃ} (a ⊔ ℓ ⊔ ι) (P {β = α}{ρᵃ} ℓ ι 𝒦)
 S⊆SP {ι} (𝑨 , (kA , B≤A )) = 𝑨 , (pA , B≤A)
  where
  pA : 𝑨 ∈ P ℓ ι 𝒦
  pA = ⊤ , (λ _ → 𝑨) , (λ _ → kA) , ≅⨅⁺-refl

 P⊆SP : ∀{ι} → P ℓ ι 𝒦 ⊆ S (a ⊔ ℓ ⊔ ι) (P {β = α}{ρᵃ}ℓ ι 𝒦)
 P⊆SP {ι} x = S-expa{ℓ = a ⊔ ℓ ⊔ ι} x


 P⊆HSP : ∀{ι} →  P {β = α}{ρᵃ} ℓ ι 𝒦
                 ⊆ H (a ⊔ ℓ ⊔ ι) (S {β = α}{ρᵃ}(a ⊔ ℓ ⊔ ι) (P {β = α}{ρᵃ}ℓ ι 𝒦))
 P⊆HSP {ι} x = H-expa{ℓ = a ⊔ ℓ ⊔ ι}  (S-expa{ℓ = a ⊔ ℓ ⊔ ι} x)

 P⊆V : ∀{ι} → P ℓ ι 𝒦 ⊆ V ℓ ι 𝒦
 P⊆V = P⊆HSP

 SP⊆V : ∀{ι} → S{β = α}{ρᵇ = ρᵃ} (a ⊔ ℓ ⊔ ι) (P {β = α}{ρᵃ} ℓ ι 𝒦) ⊆ V ℓ ι 𝒦
 SP⊆V {ι} x = H-expa{ℓ = a ⊔ ℓ ⊔ ι} x
```


Finally, we are in a position to prove that a product of subalgebras of algebras
in a class 𝒦 is a subalgebra of a product of algebras in 𝒦.


```agda

 PS⊆SP {𝑩} (I , ( 𝒜 , sA , B≅⨅A )) = Goal
  where
  ℬ : I → Algebra α ρᵃ
  ℬ i = (proj₁ (sA i))
  kB : (i : I) → ℬ i ∈ 𝒦
  kB i =  proj₁ (proj₂ (sA i))
  ⨅A≤⨅B : ⨅ 𝒜 ≤ ⨅ ℬ
  ⨅A≤⨅B = ⨅-≤ λ i → proj₂ (proj₂ (sA i))
  Goal : 𝑩 ∈ S{β = oaℓ}{oaℓ}oaℓ (P {β = oaℓ}{oaℓ} ℓ oaℓ 𝒦)
  Goal = ⨅ ℬ , (I , (ℬ , (kB , ≅-refl))) , (≅-trans-≤ B≅⨅A ⨅A≤⨅B)
```

```

```agda

 H-id2 Hpq 𝑨 kA = Hpq 𝑨 (𝑨 , (kA , IdHomImage))
```

```agda

### Equation preservation for setoid algebras

This is the [Setoid.Varieties.Preservation][] module of the [Agda Universal Algebra Library][] where we show
that the classes \af H `𝒦`{.AgdaBound}, \af S `𝒦`{.AgdaBound}, \af P `𝒦`{.AgdaBound}, and \af V `𝒦`{.AgdaBound} all satisfy the
same identities.


```agda
{-# OPTIONS --cubical-compatible --exact-split #-}

open import Overture using (𝓞 ; 𝓥 ; Signature)

module Setoid.Varieties.Preservation {𝑆 : Signature 𝓞 𝓥} where

-- Imports from Agda and the Agda Standard Library -------------------------------
open import Agda.Primitive         using ()       renaming ( Set to Type )
open import Data.Product           using ( _,_ )
open import Data.Unit.Polymorphic  using ( ⊤ )
open import Function               using ( _∘_ )  renaming ( Func to _⟶_ )
open import Level                  using ( Level ; _⊔_ )
open import Relation.Binary        using ( Setoid )
open import Relation.Unary         using ( Pred ; _⊆_ ; _∈_ )

-- Imports from the Agda Universal Algebra Library -------------------------------
open import Overture          using ( proj₁ ; proj₂ )
open import Setoid.Functions  using ( IsSurjective ; SurjInv ; SurjInvIsInverseʳ )

open import Overture.Terms   {𝑆 = 𝑆} using ( Term )
open import Setoid.Algebras  {𝑆 = 𝑆} using ( Algebra ; ov ; 𝕌[_] ; Lift-Alg ; ⨅ )

open  import Setoid.Homomorphisms {𝑆 = 𝑆}
      using ( ≅⨅⁺-refl ; ≅-refl ; IdHomImage ; ≅-sym )
open  import Setoid.Terms {𝑆 = 𝑆}
      using ( module Environment; comm-hom-term )
open  import Setoid.Subalgebras {𝑆 = 𝑆}
      using ( _≤_ ; _≤c_ ; ⨅-≤ ; ≅-trans-≤ ; ≤-reflexive )
open  import Setoid.Varieties.Closure {𝑆 = 𝑆}
      using ( H ; S ; P ; S-expa ; H-expa ; V ; P-expa ; V-expa ;Level-closure )
open  import Setoid.Varieties.Properties {𝑆 = 𝑆}
      using ( ⊧-H-invar ; ⊧-S-invar ; ⊧-P-invar ; ⊧-I-invar )
open  import Setoid.Varieties.SoundAndComplete {𝑆 = 𝑆}
      using ( _⊧_ ; _⊨_ ; _⊫_ ; Eq ; _≈̇_ ; lhs ; rhs ; _⊢_▹_≈_ ; Th)

open _⟶_      using ( cong ) renaming ( to to _⟨$⟩_ )
open Algebra  using ( Domain )
```



#### Closure properties

The types defined above represent operators with useful closure properties. We now
prove a handful of such properties that we need later.


```agda
module _  {α ρᵃ ℓ : Level}{𝒦 : Pred(Algebra α ρᵃ) (α ⊔ ρᵃ ⊔ ov ℓ)} where
 private
  a = α ⊔ ρᵃ
  oaℓ = ov (a ⊔ ℓ)

 S⊆SP : ∀{ι} → S ℓ 𝒦 ⊆ S {β = α}{ρᵃ} (a ⊔ ℓ ⊔ ι) (P {β = α}{ρᵃ} ℓ ι 𝒦)
 S⊆SP {ι} (𝑨 , (kA , B≤A )) = 𝑨 , (pA , B≤A)
  where
  pA : 𝑨 ∈ P ℓ ι 𝒦
  pA = ⊤ , (λ _ → 𝑨) , (λ _ → kA) , ≅⨅⁺-refl

 P⊆SP : ∀{ι} → P ℓ ι 𝒦 ⊆ S (a ⊔ ℓ ⊔ ι) (P {β = α}{ρᵃ}ℓ ι 𝒦)
 P⊆SP {ι} x = S-expa{ℓ = a ⊔ ℓ ⊔ ι} x


 P⊆HSP : ∀{ι} →  P {β = α}{ρᵃ} ℓ ι 𝒦
                 ⊆ H (a ⊔ ℓ ⊔ ι) (S {β = α}{ρᵃ}(a ⊔ ℓ ⊔ ι) (P {β = α}{ρᵃ}ℓ ι 𝒦))
 P⊆HSP {ι} x = H-expa{ℓ = a ⊔ ℓ ⊔ ι}  (S-expa{ℓ = a ⊔ ℓ ⊔ ι} x)

 P⊆V : ∀{ι} → P ℓ ι 𝒦 ⊆ V ℓ ι 𝒦
 P⊆V = P⊆HSP

 SP⊆V : ∀{ι} → S{β = α}{ρᵇ = ρᵃ} (a ⊔ ℓ ⊔ ι) (P {β = α}{ρᵃ} ℓ ι 𝒦) ⊆ V ℓ ι 𝒦
 SP⊆V {ι} x = H-expa{ℓ = a ⊔ ℓ ⊔ ι} x
```


Finally, we are in a position to prove that a product of subalgebras of algebras
in a class 𝒦 is a subalgebra of a product of algebras in 𝒦.


```agda
 PS⊆SP : P (a ⊔ ℓ) oaℓ (S{β = α}{ρᵃ} ℓ 𝒦) ⊆ S oaℓ (P ℓ oaℓ 𝒦)
 PS⊆SP {𝑩} (I , ( 𝒜 , sA , B≅⨅A )) = Goal
  where
  ℬ : I → Algebra α ρᵃ
  ℬ i = (proj₁ (sA i))
  kB : (i : I) → ℬ i ∈ 𝒦
  kB i =  proj₁ (proj₂ (sA i))
  ⨅A≤⨅B : ⨅ 𝒜 ≤ ⨅ ℬ
  ⨅A≤⨅B = ⨅-≤ λ i → proj₂ (proj₂ (sA i))
  Goal : 𝑩 ∈ S{β = oaℓ}{oaℓ}oaℓ (P {β = oaℓ}{oaℓ} ℓ oaℓ 𝒦)
  Goal = ⨅ ℬ , (I , (ℬ , (kB , ≅-refl))) , (≅-trans-≤ B≅⨅A ⨅A≤⨅B)
```


#### H preserves identities

First we prove that the closure operator H is compatible with identities that hold in the given class.


```agda
module _   {α ρᵃ ℓ χ : Level}
           {𝒦 : Pred(Algebra α ρᵃ) (α ⊔ ρᵃ ⊔ ov ℓ)}
           {X : Type χ}
           {p q : Term X}
           where

 H-id1 : 𝒦 ⊫ (p ≈̇ q) → H {β = α}{ρᵃ}ℓ 𝒦 ⊫ (p ≈̇ q)
 H-id1 σ 𝑩 (𝑨 , kA , BimgA) = ⊧-H-invar{p = p}{q} (σ 𝑨 kA) BimgA
```


The converse of the foregoing result is almost too obvious to bother with. Nonetheless, we formalize it for completeness.


```agda

This is the [Setoid.Varieties.Preservation][] module of the [Agda Universal Algebra Library][] where we show

open  import Setoid.Homomorphisms {𝑆 = 𝑆}
      using ( ≅⨅⁺-refl ; ≅-refl ; IdHomImage ; ≅-sym )

      using ( H ; S ; P ; S-expa ; H-expa ; V ; P-expa ; V-expa ;Level-closure )

#### Closure properties

The types defined above represent operators with useful closure properties. We now
prove a handful of such properties that we need later.


```agda
module _  {α ρᵃ ℓ : Level}{𝒦 : Pred(Algebra α ρᵃ) (α ⊔ ρᵃ ⊔ ov ℓ)} where
 private
  a = α ⊔ ρᵃ
  oaℓ = ov (a ⊔ ℓ)

 S⊆SP : ∀{ι} → S ℓ 𝒦 ⊆ S {β = α}{ρᵃ} (a ⊔ ℓ ⊔ ι) (P {β = α}{ρᵃ} ℓ ι 𝒦)
 S⊆SP {ι} (𝑨 , (kA , B≤A )) = 𝑨 , (pA , B≤A)
  where
  pA : 𝑨 ∈ P ℓ ι 𝒦
  pA = ⊤ , (λ _ → 𝑨) , (λ _ → kA) , ≅⨅⁺-refl

 P⊆SP : ∀{ι} → P ℓ ι 𝒦 ⊆ S (a ⊔ ℓ ⊔ ι) (P {β = α}{ρᵃ}ℓ ι 𝒦)
 P⊆SP {ι} x = S-expa{ℓ = a ⊔ ℓ ⊔ ι} x


 P⊆HSP : ∀{ι} →  P {β = α}{ρᵃ} ℓ ι 𝒦
                 ⊆ H (a ⊔ ℓ ⊔ ι) (S {β = α}{ρᵃ}(a ⊔ ℓ ⊔ ι) (P {β = α}{ρᵃ}ℓ ι 𝒦))
 P⊆HSP {ι} x = H-expa{ℓ = a ⊔ ℓ ⊔ ι}  (S-expa{ℓ = a ⊔ ℓ ⊔ ι} x)

 P⊆V : ∀{ι} → P ℓ ι 𝒦 ⊆ V ℓ ι 𝒦
 P⊆V = P⊆HSP

 SP⊆V : ∀{ι} → S{β = α}{ρᵇ = ρᵃ} (a ⊔ ℓ ⊔ ι) (P {β = α}{ρᵃ} ℓ ι 𝒦) ⊆ V ℓ ι 𝒦
 SP⊆V {ι} x = H-expa{ℓ = a ⊔ ℓ ⊔ ι} x
```

```agda

 PS⊆SP {𝑩} (I , ( 𝒜 , sA , B≅⨅A )) = Goal
  where
  ℬ : I → Algebra α ρᵃ
  ℬ i = (proj₁ (sA i))
  kB : (i : I) → ℬ i ∈ 𝒦
  kB i =  proj₁ (proj₂ (sA i))
  ⨅A≤⨅B : ⨅ 𝒜 ≤ ⨅ ℬ

  Goal = ⨅ ℬ , (I , (ℬ , (kB , ≅-refl))) , (≅-trans-≤ B≅⨅A ⨅A≤⨅B)
```
